diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references

aws_eks_node_group.ng lists aws_iam_role.ng in its depends_on, but the ordering is already guaranteed by the direct attribute reference node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.ng.0.arn; the explicit depends_on entry duplicates it.

aws_autoscaling_group.ng lists aws_launch_template.ng in its depends_on, but the ordering is already guaranteed by the direct attribute references launch_template_id = aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].id and version = aws_launch_template.ng[each.key].latest_version; the explicit depends_on entry duplicates them.

aws_autoscaling_group.ng lists aws_iam_role.ng in its depends_on, but this ordering is already established transitively through attribute references: aws_autoscaling_group.ng references aws_launch_template.ng, which references aws_iam_instance_profile.ng, which references aws_iam_role.ng. The explicit depends_on entry adds nothing.
